notes.title: Balance Update and General Improvements!
notes.notes:
A new update has arrived with significant changes to make your experience even more exciting and smooth!

Bug fixes: Addressed issues that could disrupt your journey, including shooting when clicking on UI buttons.

Balance adjustments: Fine-tuned enemies and game elements to provide well-paced challenges.

UI improvements: Made navigation more intuitive with visual and functional adjustments.

Performance optimization: The game is now faster and smoother, with better transitions.

General polish: Small tweaks to enhance the overall player experience.


This update marks another step in improving Survivor's Dawn. Enjoy the new features and keep exploring!

notes.title: Survivor’s Dawn Version 2 – Gameplay and Control Upgrades
notes.notes:
Map Fixes: Improved boundaries and map adjustments to enhance gameplay.
Game Over Screen: New Game Over screen design, and includes options to restart (“Play Again”) or return to the main menu (“Main Menu”).
Controls System Enhancements:
Added a “Restore Default” button to reset controls to their original key bindings.
Improved remapping experience: while remapping a key, the button will show “Press” until a new key is selected.
Control configurations now save and restore seamlessly across scenes, with the option to restore defaults at any time.
